what: PR #87 starters.capture_starters (code 5fc63c3, unchanged) polled every 3 min on a runner against live ESPN core-roster endpoints for the 2026-11-04 slate (first tip 2026-11-05T00:00Z)

provenance.cross_check: nba-edge-finder run 41924464469 (another session, 23:16-00:43Z) found the same two defects; fixed in nba-edge-finder d31d6dd

first_confirmed.note: all four teams (two games, same 00:00Z tip) flipped from no flags to exactly 5 flags between 22.0 and 18.9 minutes before tip and stayed CONFIRMED to 0.5 min before tip (7 consecutive polls). Resolution is the 3-min poll interval. Never saw 1-4 flags (no partial lineups).

unobserved_games.why: my probe's own schedule query used UTC dates today+tomorrow, so after 00:00Z the games listed under the previous US-Eastern date vanished (poll log: 16 future games / 9 fetched at 23:59:26Z, 11 / 0 at 00:02:31Z). Those 7 games (tips 00:30-01:30Z) have observations only down to 30.5/60.5/90.5 minutes before tip, none confirmed - consistent with, but not evidence for, a ~20 minute publication time.
unobserved_games.same_defect_in_pr87: context.run_context_refresh used the same UTC-date window, so production capture would have lost the evening slate after 00:00 UTC; fixed in nba-edge-finder d31d6dd

cadence_adequacy.six_minute_refresh: a 6-minute cadence inside the 40-minute window places 3 observations in a ~19-minute confirmed window (arithmetic on the measured window, 2 games only). It is only as good as the capture worker's actual wake rate, which this probe did NOT measure (the repo comment cites ~3.9% cron delivery).
cadence_adequacy.strict_rules: exactly-5 distinct flags and observed-before-tip held: no CONFIRMED row has minutes_to_tip < 0

limits: only 2 games (4 teams) cover the whole pre-tip window; 7 more are truncated by my schedule bug
this is source availability measured by a probe; PR #87 is unmerged, so no production archive of context/starters exists
not measured: late changes after first publication, scratches inside the last 20 minutes, back-to-back/holiday slates
